scenes.purpose: Introduce the topic of elections and their importance in a democracy.
scenes.teacher_script: Hello, young citizens! Today, we're going to explore how we choose our leaders in India. We'll learn about the exciting process of elections, specifically for the State Legislative Assembly.

template_data.title: The Process of Elections in India
template_data.subtitle: Choosing Our Leaders for the State Assembly

scenes.purpose: Explain the essential qualifications for a person to contest in state assembly elections.
scenes.teacher_script: To stand in an election and become an MLA, there are some important rules candidates must follow. Let's look at who is eligible to contest!

main_concept.name: Aspiring MLA
main_concept.description: A person who wishes to be elected as a Member of Legislative Assembly.

scenes.purpose: Highlight the role of political parties, independent candidates, manifestos, and campaigning in elections.
scenes.teacher_script: Political parties play a huge role in elections, but individuals can also contest! Let's understand how they reach out to voters and what promises they make.

bullets: Organize large campaigns, meetings, and rallies.
Contest elections without belonging to any party.
Must get a unique symbol allotted.

scenes.purpose: Explain the concepts of voters and electoral constituencies, and how they relate to electing MLAs.
scenes.teacher_script: Before voting, an area is divided into smaller units called constituencies. And remember, every voter must be registered in their specific area!

template_data.title: Dividing the Vote: Constituencies & Voters
template_data.map_description: An illustrative map of a state, visually divided into several distinct, colored 'constituency' regions. Voter icons and constituency labels appear with animations.

markers.label: Voter Registration
markers.description: Voters must register their names in the area where they live.

markers.label: Electoral Constituency
markers.description: Each region (villages, towns, cities) is divided into constituencies.

markers.label: One MLA per Constituency
markers.description: All voters of one constituency elect one MLA for the Assembly.

markers.label: Population & Constituencies
markers.description: Districts with larger populations have more constituencies.

scenes.purpose: Illustrate the cyclical nature of state assembly elections and the role of the Election Commission.
scenes.teacher_script: The entire election process is managed by an independent body called the Election Commission. They ensure free and fair elections, which typically occur every five years.

template_data.title: The Election Cycle for State Assemblies
stages: Counting of Votes & Declaration of Results
Formation of New State Legislative Assembly
template_data.description: The Election Commission conducts elections to the state legislative assembly, usually once every five years.

scenes.purpose: Reinforce understanding of a key eligibility criterion for contesting elections.
scenes.teacher_script: Great job following along! Now, let's quickly check your understanding of India's election process.

template_data.question: What is the minimum age required to contest elections for a State Legislative Assembly in India?
template_data.explanation: According to the textbook, a person must have completed twenty-five years of age to contest elections.
